[5] (ran1_tdoc_chunks R1-2203324, sim=0.5312)
Though Rel-15/16/17 SRS is UE-specifically designed, it can hardly handle the inter-TRP SRS interference under mTRP. There are two main categories to minimize the inter-TRP SRS interference. The first orientation to create randomization on sequence level. The SRSs transmitted toward different TRP can have different sequence randomizing parameters. The other orientation inherits the idea of LTE CRS, where CRS belonging to different serving cell can have different shifts. Similarly, in Rel-18 we can study the TRP-specific SRS shift which instead creates randomization for SRS locations among TRPs. Proposal 3: Per-TRP SRS sequence-randomization/shifts can be studied in Rel-18.

[6] (ran1_tdoc_chunks R1-2208015, sim=0.5229)
Many companies have expressed interest and support for Rel-18 SRS enhancements for TDD CJT and 8 Tx, as partially demonstrated by the large number of potential enhancement proposals from the last and present RAN1 meetings. A variety of LLS and SLS have been provided [2, 4, 5, 10, 16, 20, 24], which shows the benefits with enhanced SRS on top of existing Rel-17 standards. These are generally aligned with the collective view expressed by operators on the promising gain from CJT field test [27] and the common understanding of the usefulness for 8 Tx SRS. While the discussions on specific enhancements are ongoing and may take multiple meetings, it seems that there is a sufficient amount of support from companies to justify moving forward with the specification work at the high level. Therefore

provenance.text: Further study M-TRP CG PUSCH reliability enhancements in Rel-17.
For Rel-20 study, adopt the TP in Moderator’s evaluation summary attached in R1-2509500 into TR38.769
No consensus on enhanced per-TRP power control and/or power control of one SRS towards to multiple TRPs in Rel-18.
The following TPs for TS38.213 for Rel.18 are endorsed.

Though Rel-15/16/17 SRS is UE-specifically designed, it can hardly handle the inter-TRP SRS interference under mTRP. There are two main categories to minimize the inter-TRP SRS interference. The first orientation to create randomization on sequence level. The SRSs transmitted toward different TRP can have different sequence randomizing parameters. The other orientation inherits the idea of LTE CRS, where CRS belonging to different serving cell can have different shifts. Similarly, in Rel-18 we can study the TRP-specific SRS shift which instead creates randomization for SRS locations among TRPs. Proposal 3: Per-TRP SRS sequence-randomization/shifts can be studied in Rel-18.

Many companies have expressed interest and support for Rel-18 SRS enhancements for TDD CJT and 8 Tx, as partially demonstrated by the large number of potential enhancement proposals from the last and present RAN1 meetings. A variety of LLS and SLS have been provided [2, 4, 5, 10, 16, 20, 24], which shows the benefits with enhanced SRS on top of existing Rel-17 standards. These are generally aligned with the collective view expressed by operators on the promising gain from CJT field test [27] and the common understanding of the usefulness for 8 Tx SRS. While the discussions on specific enhancements are ongoing and may take multiple meetings, it seems that there is a sufficient amount of support from companies to justify moving forward with the specification work at the high level. Therefore
